# Interview P2
Participant: P2
Role: Product designer
Date: 2026-09-09
Segment: Design lead
Method: interview

Q: How does AI output reach your team today?
P2: I read every line before it goes to the team.
P2: If I can't see what changed, I redo it myself.
Q: How do you brief the AI?
P2: I keep a doc just to brief the AI.
P2: The agent forgets what we decided yesterday unless I remind it.
Q: Where does the work end up?
P2: Half of it lives in Figma, half in Notion, and the decisions live in Slack.
Q: What would make review easier?
P2: Show me what it did as it does it, not a wall of text at the end.
